capabilities: render TikZ code blocks as diagrams in notes
cache compiled diagrams in a .tikz-cache/ folder
extras: Obsidian staff have not manually reviewed the plugin. On mobile, uncached diagrams do not render until the note is opened on desktop first; compiled diagrams are cached to a .tikz-cache/ folder in the vault, which syncs with Obsidian Sync or other sync services.
intentEvidence: the original inspiration for this plugin, this repo aims to be a modernised spiritual successor
motivation: The author wanted to modernise obsidian-tikzjax, crediting it as the original inspiration for this plugin.
problem: Obsidian's built-in LaTeX support renders math but not TikZ diagram code, so users must compile diagrams elsewhere and embed images.

relations.evidence: the original inspiration for this plugin, this repo aims to be a modernised spiritual successor
node-tikzjax - the underlying TikZ rendering library

summary: Renderer that compiles TikZ, CircuiTikZ and PGFPlots code written in tikz code blocks into diagrams displayed directly in notes.
